cargo_runner_policy: VYRE_CARGO_RUNNER if set; otherwise ./cargo_full when executable; otherwise cargo
test_roster_source: git ls-files -- 'vyre-driver-cuda/tests/*.rs', run through the crate's documented test command
test_roster_note: This file used to carry two hardcoded rosters, a contract list and a *gpu_parity* list. Both were copies of what the gate discovers, and the contract copy still named cuda_device_contract after 8a66e4b65b deleted it. A roster recorded here cannot be the roster that ran, so it is stated as a policy and a count instead.
